content.comment_body: Hello, I have another question: Is it possible to remotely access two independent [product_name] modules [version_no] behind the same router? Remotely accessing one works fine, but I want to access both. Thank you for your help.
Can you clarify what you mean by 'remote'? Are you referring to access from other controllers, via an app, or over the internet using VPN?

Thank you [user_name]. By 'remote' I mean access over the internet, specifically using port forwarding. The issue is both devices use the same port. VPN will be part of the upcoming project, but currently my office doesn’t have it. I need remote access from home to download files to the [product_name] and test at the site. There’s another [product_name] working for HVAC in the office network. Local access to both devices is straightforward. If VPN allows remote access, I will implement it in the office. I appreciate your help.

analysis.insight_summary: Users want to remotely access two independent [product_name] modules [version_no] located behind the same router. The main challenge is both devices use identical ports, making standard port forwarding ineffective for simultaneous connections. While local access is reliable, remote file download needs expose remote access limitations without VPN.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to manage multiple [product_name] modules [version_no] behind a router by setting up individual port forwarding, or to have an official, streamlined solution for remote access that avoids network port conflicts.
